description: Local MCP server that exposes SAP Business One data as read-only tools (Service Layer read tools, online or scheduled SQL queries, multi-step investigations) for AI assistants and applications, over Streamable HTTP on 127.0.0.1 with Bearer access tokens.
rules: Connect with Streamable HTTP to http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp (default port 50002) using the header Authorization: Bearer <token>; read URL and token from configuration.
Call the MCP endpoint only from server-side code on the same computer; browser requests with an Origin header are rejected.
Discover tools with tools/list at runtime; tool names and lookup arguments differ per installation.
Pass only the arguments declared in each tool's inputSchema; SQL, OData filters and collection names are not accepted.
Read results from structuredContent; follow has_more and next_skip, and pass snapshot_version when paging scheduled sap_query_* tools.
Treat isError results and investigation steps with error or skipped as unavailable evidence, never as no records.
Prefer investigate_* tools over chaining sap_read_* tools manually for multi-step questions.
